entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. To check an order status, press 1. For technical support, press 2. For returns or exchanges, press 3.
Connecting you to a returns specialist now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi Diana, I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. I'd like to see about returning it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and order number to pull up your account?
Of course. The name is Alex Chen, and the order number is VF881-25.

Thank you, Alex. I see the order here, delivered on December 15th. Before we go further, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

It's definitely a preference thing. To be honest, it's just really hard to use. I've read the user manual a couple of times, but the app interface is still so confusing. I just expected more in terms of user-friendliness.
I understand completely. Sometimes a device just doesn't click with your personal workflow. I appreciate you clarifying that it's not a technical defect. Let me just check our policy for you.
Okay. I know it's been a few weeks, so I wasn't sure what the options were. If a full return isn't possible, maybe a store credit or a discount on a different model would work?
One moment, Alex... Okay, I've got it pulled up. It looks like our policy allows for returns within 90 days of delivery. Since you received it 28 days ago, you're well within that window.
Oh, 90 days? That's great! So a full refund is possible?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's in the original condition, we can process a full refund for you. I'm emailing you a pre-paid return shipping label right now. Just pack the VeloBand back in its box, attach the label, and drop it off at any post office.
That's fantastic. I really appreciate how easy you've made this. Thank you, Diana.
You're very welcome, Alex. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again for your help!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
